a1.cap: Token Bucket Rate Limiter
a1.say: Let's solve Token Bucket Rate Limiter, using the Lazy Refill approach.

a1.cap: Implement TokenBucket(capacity, rate): the bucket starts full with capacity tokens and gains rate tokens per second (never exceeding capacity). allow(t) is called with non-decreasing whole-second timestamps; it refills the bucket for the elapsed time, then spends one token and returns true, or returns false if the bucket is empty.

a1.cap: Don't run a timer. On each call, add rate × elapsed seconds tokens, capped at capacity, then try to spend one.

a1.cap: Token buckets allow short bursts up to the capacity while enforcing the average rate. API gateways and LLM providers use them for per-key limits.
